title: ACCESS-OM3 experiments list
description: Schema for experiments.yaml, which generates the tables on pages/Experiments.md. Checked by .github/workflows/validate-experiments.yml.

experiment.description: Run name; must be unique in the file (checked by the script, not the schema).

group.description: Which table the run appears in.

nominal_resolution.description: Same name and format as metadata.yaml (ACCESS-NRI experiment-metadata schema).

branch.description: Branch name shown as the link text (defaults to the short commit).

commit.description: Commit in ACCESS-NRI/access-om3-configs the run used.

name.description: ACCESS-OM3 release, e.g. "2026.05.004", or a pre-release, e.g. "access-om3/pr264-25". Quote it in YAML, or a value like 2026.05 is read as a number.

url.description: Link for the build. Defaults to the ACCESS-OM3 release page for `name`; give it for a pre-release (the PR comment announcing that build).

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, roughly when the run was done.

datastore.description: Path to the ESM datastore JSON on Gadi.
